items: P2.3 (sixth retained unit and low-M Q4/Q5/Q6 kernel-family closure)
title: Low-VGPR Q5 dense prefill selector retained on gfx1151

host.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S

change.summary: Override only the gfx1151 dense-linear gguf_q5_k_t16_v1 t16_wmma_prefill key. Rows 17-32 use the <2,1> 16-column owner on six physical shapes; rows 33-48 use <2,1> on (17408,5120), <3,1> on four measured winners, and retain plain on (5120,17408). Row/shape misses, compact MoE, and target-verifier aliases retain their prior exact owners.

selection_evidence.harness: /tmp/p210_ab.py, repeated after restoring the Q5 default kernel's __restrict__ qualifier; synthetic Q5T16, warmup 4 + 20 iterations
selection_evidence.exactness: all plain/lowvgpr/lowvgpr48 outputs bit-exact on six physical shapes at rows 24 and 45 (max_abs 0.0)

server_prefill_frozen_protocol.command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 .venv/bin/python3 scripts/gguf_mtp_c1c8_server_bench.py --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf --backend hip_gfx1151 --quant Q4_K_M --execution-profile production --prompts benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl --widths 1,2 --max-tokens 1 --candidate-budget 3 --batch-window-ms 50 --max-sequence-length 1024 --expected-mtp-widths '' --correctness-contract ar_exact --output /tmp/p212-server-c1c2-q5lowvgpr.json

c2_initial_run.note: One final AR arm incurred an extra 0.512 s while the immediately following route-identical K0/MTP arm was normal. A repeat reproduced this scheduler state, so a clean same-protocol plain-owner control was required.

c2_controlled_ab.verdict: neutral/no route effect: every C2 packed slab exceeds row 48, so the Q5 selector is inactive; the final-arm scheduler state reproduces in candidate and plain control

server_prefill_frozen_protocol.correctness: candidate C1/C2, repeated candidate C2, and clean plain C2 control passed every ar_self_exact, mtp_self_exact, ar_mtp_equal, route-expectation, and budget-conformance cell

kernel_trace_evidence.command: cached-build rocprofv3 --kernel-trace on the isolated 45-token forced-bulk benchmark
kernel_trace_evidence.cache_only_variant_trace: <2,1> and <3,1> each launched eight times under expected names at 96/112 VGPR; no compiler ran inside rocprofv3

gates.red_green: RED failed because gfx1151 lacked a Q5 prefill selector; GREEN route/registry-scope node passed
gates.registry_scope: dense linear key resolves to the Q5 selector; compact MoE key remains the original selected_wmma_prefill_compact owner
gates.mechanical: compileall, check_fixtures, registry smoke, CPU-fixture smoke, worklog check, and diff check passed
gates.full_suite: configured broad suite retains the known test_specdec2_perf_bridge order failure documented in preceding iterations; affected nodes pass in isolation

parity_context.p2_3_status: closed: measured low-M Q4, Q5, and Q6 T16 families now use exact low-register owners with required traces
parity_context.next: attribute the residual C1 host/serving wall and re-freeze C1-C8 under P2.1/P2.2
